title: Yellow Charred Mexican Tomato Tacos
description: A lazy Sunday Mexican dish featuring char-grilled tomatoes and a hint of grassy flavor, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a relaxing afternoon meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the tomatoes with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the tomatoes for about 3-4 minutes per side, until they have a nice char.
While the tomatoes are grilling, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once the tomatoes are done, let them cool for a minute or two before chopping them into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped tomatoes, sliced onion, and chopped cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the tomato mixture and toss to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the tomato mixture onto a warmed tortilla and serving immediately.
